name: BibleBridge
author: Derek Ziemer

sections.description:
Share God’s Word alongside your products and services. BibleBridge integrates a complete, interactive Bible into your WordPress site as a meaningful witness to every visitor. Your domain, your name, your readers. Built for Christian businesses, ministries, churches, and Bible bloggers.

No YouVersion links. No BibleGateway iframes. Just Scripture, fully on your site.

What makes it different

BibleBridge is one consistent Bible, not four separate tools bolted together.

  • Everything stays on your domain, under your name and logo. No accounts, no ads, no tracking for your visitors
  • Scripture Atlas: visitors explore how Bible themes connect across seven hand-illustrated regions, not just one passage at a time
  • Cross-references chosen for how they fit the passage, not just shared words, so study time goes to real connections instead of noise
  • Switch translations once and reading, search, cross-references, and topics all follow — nothing to reconfigure

What’s included

  • Scripture Atlas: seven hand-illustrated regions connecting Bible topics through shared verses, from core doctrine to everyday Christian life
  • Auto-Tagging: enable once and BibleBridge automatically finds scripture references in every post, adding hover tooltips with the verse text
  • Cross-references: tap any verse to see related passages
  • Both KJV and Berean Standard Bible (BSB), public domain, included on every plan – no translation paywall
  • Full-text search with book filtering
  • Five reading plans: Bible in a Year, NT in 90 Days, NT in a Year, Gospel of John, Psalms & Proverbs
  • Highlights, notes, and verse sharing, with cloud sync across devices using a simple code – no account required
  • Dark mode and a mobile layout
  • Shortcodes to embed Scripture anywhere on your site – chapters, verses, Verse of the Day, and reading plans. For example: [biblebridge_verse ref="John 3:16"]

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings → BibleBridge
  3. Set your name (for example, “Grace Church Bible”)
  4. Your Bible is live at yoursite.com/bible

Free, with everything included

The free tier includes both translations, every feature (search, Scripture Atlas, reading plans, cross-references, sync, shortcodes), and 250 scripture loads per day. No ads, no tracking, no account wall. Need higher usage limits? Upgrade anytime from Settings → BibleBridge.

The free tier is for personal, ministry, educational, and other non-commercial use. If your site sells products or services, a paid plan is required regardless of usage volume – see Terms of Service for details.

Built on trust

Every file ships as readable source. No obfuscation, no hidden build steps. You can see exactly what runs on your site.

External Services

This plugin relies on the BibleBridge API to serve Bible text, cross-references, search results, topic data, and reading plans. No Bible data is stored locally – all scripture content is fetched on demand from the API.

The plugin connects to the following services hosted at holybible.dev:

  • BibleBridge API (holybible.dev/api) – serves all Bible content including scripture text, search, cross-references, topics, and reading plan data. On plugin activation, the plugin sends your site URL and site name to automatically provision a free API key. During normal use, visitor search queries and page navigation result in API calls that include the API key and requested scripture references. No visitor personal data is collected or transmitted.
  • BibleBridge Sync (holybible.dev/reader/sync.php) – provides optional cross-device sync for visitor highlights, notes, and reading progress. Sync is initiated by visitors using an anonymous code (no email or account required). No personally identifiable information is collected.
  • BibleBridge Verification Ping (holybible.dev/api/verify-beacon) – on page load, the visitor’s browser sends a small signed confirmation directly to BibleBridge, bypassing your WordPress installation. This includes the visitor’s IP address and browser user-agent, logged only to verify that automated-traffic detection is working correctly. It is not linked to any personal information and is not used to track or profile individual visitors.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Source Code

Every file ships as readable source – no obfuscation or hidden build steps. You can see exactly what runs on your site.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “BibleBridge” and click Install Now
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Go to Settings → BibleBridge to set your reader name
  5. Find your reader URL under Page URL in Settings → BibleBridge and add it as a custom link in your navigation menu

For manual installation: upload the biblebridge folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate through the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Is my visitors’ data private?

Yes. No personal data is collected from visitors. No accounts, no tracking. One cookie remembers your visitor’s translation choice – nothing else. Cloud sync uses an anonymous code – no email or password required. See the full Privacy Policy.

Does this work out of the box?

Yes. The plugin works immediately with no setup required. A free API key is automatically provisioned for your site on activation. For usage alerts and higher limits, go to Settings → BibleBridge in your WordPress admin and claim your site from there.

Who is this for?

Christian businesses, ministries, and churches that want Scripture to feel native to their own website – not embedded from external tools or sent to other apps. For a business, it’s a way to share God’s Word alongside your products and services – a meaningful witness to every visitor.

Is the free plan available for a commercial website?

No. The free tier is for personal, ministry, educational, and other non-commercial use. If your site sells products or services, a paid plan is required regardless of how much traffic you get – see the Terms of Service for the full policy.

What translations are included?

King James Version (KJV) and Berean Standard Bible (BSB).

Does it slow down my site?

No. All styles and scripts are bundled with the plugin. Bible data is fetched on demand from the API. No heavy assets or database tables are added to your site.

Can visitors sync across devices?

Yes. Cloud sync uses a simple code (like “GRACE-4821”) – no email or password needed. Highlights, reading progress, and plan completion sync automatically.

Can I customize the URL?

Yes. By default the reader lives at /bible but you can change this in Settings → BibleBridge.

Does it work with my theme?

The reader uses its own full-page template and includes safeguards to prevent most styling conflicts. It’s actively tested against real installations of popular free WordPress themes and page builders, not just checked in isolation, and works without issue in the large majority of cases.

Some themes or plugins apply aggressive global styles – such as button or link hover effects – that can occasionally show up in the reader. If you notice anything unexpected, try temporarily switching themes to confirm the source, or contact support with a screenshot and we’ll help resolve it.

How do I add the Bible to my site navigation?

Go to Settings → BibleBridge and find your exact reader URL under Page URL, then add it as a custom link in your navigation menu.

What happens if I hit the daily limit?

Readers will see a friendly message that the reader is busy. No errors, no broken pages. Limits reset at midnight UTC. To raise limits, claim your site from the plugin’s settings page, then choose a plan at holybible.dev/pricing.

Will bots consume my quota?

BibleBridge includes server-side protections designed to identify and limit abusive automated traffic, helping preserve your quota for real visitors. No detection system catches everything, but known bots and scrapers are filtered before they count against your quota.

Does BibleBridge affect my site’s SEO?

BibleBridge does not alter your site’s existing pages or their SEO metadata—it only adds new routes for the Bible reader. If the daily quota is reached, the reader returns 503 Service Unavailable with a Retry-After header to signal that the interruption is temporary.
sections.changelog:
1.0.50

  • Improved: Scripture Atlas — refined visual details across several regions.

1.0.49

  • Improved: New Life in Christ region rebuilt.
  • Fix: Vertical imbalance on Scripture Atlas pages.
  • Improved: Clearer error messages for quota limits and account issues.

1.0.48

  • New: Scripture Atlas can now be embedded in posts and pages.

1.0.47

  • Improved: Scripture Atlas v2 — full mobile support.

1.0.46

  • Revamped Scripture Atlas.

1.0.45

  • New: Adds a BibleBridge summary to your WordPress dashboard.
  • Improved: Cross-references redesigned for a more focused study experience.
  • Improved: Search now handles book names and common words more intelligently.
  • Improved: The search box now shows a clearly visible outline when selected, on every theme.
  • Fix: The cross-reference panel no longer closes itself when you scroll back up through the list on a phone.

1.0.44

  • New: Monthly Featured Passages on the Search page — four handpicked passages that refresh each month, so there’s always something new to discover.
  • Improved: A smoother, more focused mobile search.
  • Improved: Search page redesigned to feel more like a Bible concordance, with cleaner browsing for Famous Passages, Doctrine, Relationships, and more.
  • Improved: Recent Searches remembers what you’ve looked up on this device (no account needed).

1.0.43

  • Fix: Stylesheets and scripts now refresh correctly after plugin updates.
